skill.summary: Extract text, classify document type, and pull tables from any document image. Pay $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (no API key needed).

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ntriq-x402-document-intel

- Analyze document images to extract text, classify document types, summarize, or pull tables.
- Supports input via public image URL or base64.
- No API key or cloud upload required; payment via x402 micropayments ($0.05 USDC per call, Base mainnet).
- Multiple analysis modes: extract, summarize, classify, and table extraction.
- Simple API with clear parameter options and sample responses included.
